init.title: Options for Handball Entity
init.description: Choose polling intervals or central logo management. Logos apply to all Handball.net entries; logo changes do not trigger API requests or reloads.

intervals.title: Polling intervals
intervals.description: Adjust intervals in seconds (positive whole numbers). Other options are preserved. Entries are not automatically reloaded.

logos.title: Manage central logos
logos.description: Select a known team from any entry or type another team name. The mapping applies everywhere for that name (case and extra whitespace are ignored). Per-card logo_overrides still take precedence.

logo_action.title: Edit logo
logo_action.description:
Team: {team_name}.

Set an image URL, upload a file or remove the central override. Original API images remain unchanged.

logo_url.title: Set image address
logo_url.description:
Team: {team_name}.

Enter an HTTP(S) URL or a relative path such as /local/club.png. The server does not download it. Saving replaces the central mapping for this team across all entries.

logo_upload.title: Upload image file
logo_upload.description:
Team: {team_name}.

PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 16 million pixels. No animation or SVG. The image is stored as a metadata-free PNG and is publicly accessible via /local. Saving changes the central mapping for all entries. You may need to select the file again after an error.

logo_restore.title: Restore API original
logo_restore.description:
Team: {team_name}.

Remove this team's central logo override across all entries. Cards will use the unchanged API image unless their own logo_overrides takes precedence. Uploaded files are not deleted because other mappings may still use them.

data.confirm: Confirm removal of the central override

error.invalid_interval: Enter positive whole numbers of seconds.
error.invalid_team_name: Enter a team name of 1 to 200 characters without control characters.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL without credentials or a relative image path. Other protocols, leading double slashes, backslashes and control characters are not allowed.
error.invalid_upload: The upload is missing, expired or invalid. Select the image file again.
error.invalid_image: The file is not a complete, valid single-frame PNG, JPEG or WebP image. SVG, HTML, other formats and animations are not allowed.
error.file_too_large: File too large: up to 5 MiB for the upload or 16 MiB after PNG conversion.
error.image_too_large: Image too large: up to 4096 pixels per side and 16 million pixels in total.
error.storage_error: Logo data could not be reliably loaded or saved. The change was not confirmed. Check free space and the Home Assistant log; do not overwrite existing data.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm removal of the central logo override.

abort.logo_saved: Central logo mapping saved for all entries. Polling intervals and original API images remain unchanged.
abort.logo_restored: Central logo override removed. The unchanged API image applies again unless a per-card override takes precedence. Polling intervals remain unchanged.
abort.storage_error: Central logo data could not be safely loaded. Nothing was overwritten. Check the Home Assistant log and resolve the storage error.
